indications.indication: Advanced solid tumors (HCC, CRC, pancreatic adenocarcinoma, NSCLC, SCCHN, urothelial, MSI-H) — combination with tislelizumab
indications.trial_name: Decoy20 +/- Tislelizumab in Advanced Solid Tumors (Combination Study)
indications.trial_design: Open-label, dose-escalation Phase 1/2 study of weekly Decoy20 with BeOne anti-PD-1 antibody tislelizumab
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (per CT.gov); 10-K (Mar 2026) reports enrollment discontinued in Combination Study and no participants remaining; Supply Agreement with BeOne terminated. No current plans to initiate new clinical trial.
key_milestones: May 2025: concluded enrollment in Decoy20 monotherapy weekly dosing

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Company is winding down its only clinical program (Decoy20 Combination Study) per Mar 2026 10-K — kept in pipeline as currently still listed Active/Not Recruiting on CT.gov; reader should note discontinuation of new enrollment.
